purpose: Require repository and corpus lineage reconstruction before an AEGIS primitive is declared missing or newly implemented.

stack_parent.note: PR #290 owns fail-closed artifact existence discovery. This guard adds semantic/evidence lineage and Drive triage.

rules: Artifact identity is not filename, gate number, branch name, or epistemic label alone.
Run PR #290 artifact discovery before any global existence or absence claim.
Resolve semantic role, generation, evidence tier, exact ref, and predecessor/successor relation before creating a new primitive.
A code-search hit proves presence only; it does not prove semantic continuity.
A current-tree miss does not prove absence when active PRs, historical refs, or corpus snapshots are unresolved.
Historical stronger rhetoric never overrides a later narrower implementation/evidence boundary.
Unknown lineage stays UNKNOWN; do not infer edges from lexical similarity.
Do not use a stale integration-ledger snapshot; use the exact-candidate workflow artifact.
